## Fix role regeneration churn: carry the previous role forward when a re-synced… — 2026-07-29 (parent 2023e0710a9e)

`sync_single_file` now carries the previous role forward during the apply phase when a regenerated section's prose body is byte-identical to the stored body, preventing the non-deterministic LLM role classifier from flipping labels (e.g. `api` ↔ `orchestration`) on cascade or cosmetic re-syncs where source and body are unchanged. A genuine body change still triggers reclassification normally.

Two new tests cover this:
- `test_role_carried_forward_when_body_unchanged` – asserts the existing role survives a forced re-sync that produces identical prose
- `test_role_updates_when_body_changes` – asserts a legitimately new body adopts the new role

`TrieTools` role was also restored to `api`. The shared helper `_roles_project` builds the minimal fixture both tests use.

### Changes

- + tests/test_roles:_roles_project — "Create a minimal temporary project with a `trie.toml` config and a single `svc.py` source file, returning the project root and loaded `Config`."
- + tests/test_roles:test_role_carried_forward_when_body_unchanged — "Assert that `sync_single_file` preserves the existing role when a forced re-sync produces a byte-identical body."
- + tests/test_roles:test_role_updates_when_body_changes — "Assert that `sync_single_file` adopts the new role when the regenerated body differs from the previous version."
- ~ trie/sync/single_file:sync_single_file — Role stability fix in the apply phase: when a regenerated section's prose body is byte-identical to the previous section's body, carry the previous role…
